scope: Bounded static extraction of the Stage-2 GitHub profile identity and its explicitly non-attributed repository discoveries.

unresolved_findings.finding: Paper 778 supplies only the JeongsLee parent profile URL; no repository-level official code relationship is established.
CR000145 is a profile identity and therefore has no pinned executable commit of its own.
PINN-for-ExtremeMechanics is preserved as CR000358, but its relationship to Atlas 778 remains not established.
ADAF, MOTION and NTO-ADA are profile discoveries not attributable to paper 778 from the accepted evidence.
Environment, entrypoint, data, training and evaluation reproducibility fields are not attributable at profile level.

notes: No repository-level paper relationship was inferred from scientific compatibility.
